title: McGill 1988: csa fibre corrected of external oblique at L4-L5 (M, supine)

imaging.plane: single transverse slice with the gantry tilted to the plane of the L4/L5 disc

quantity.name: csa_fibre_corrected
quantity.definition: anatomical CSA multiplied by cosine of fibre angle to the plane normal (authors may call it PCSA/physiological area; NOT volume/fibre-length PCSA); assumed 45 deg fibre angle and +25% out-of-slice factor (Eq. 1)

source.authors: McGill SM, Patt N, Norman RW
source.sample: 13 active men; men referred for diagnostic CT (most with low back pain/sciatica), screened for activity level

how_to_simulate: Pose the model supine; plane through the L4/L5 disc parallel to it.
Sum the PCSA of model external oblique fascicles crossing the plane, each side.
Compare with the corrected ("physiologic") area; note the correction factors are assumptions of the paper.

subject_model.source: Table 1 (SD age 11.9, height 5.9, weight 11.7); disc area 19.0 (2.4) cm2 Table 2

protocol.notes: Authors call it physiologic area; it is an angle-corrected anatomical area (not volume/fibre-length PCSA).
